product: GLiM / Lithological Map of the World polygon GIS
decision: Do not commit, publish or redistribute GLiM polygon geometry or per-unit derived values. Keep the bounded local overlay in the external cache and export only availability status plus this verification record.

findings.checked_source: CCGM/CGMW official product page (Lithological Map of the World, 1st edition 2015)
findings.observed: Priced map product marked '(c)CCGM-CGMW 2015'; the GIS data are distributed via the CCGM link. The PDF edition notes 'This card is subject to a licence agreement.'

Licence is granted for internal educational/research use, limited to the licensee's premises, for five years and against a fee; the licensee may not assign, sell, distribute or transfer the maps or derived products to third parties.

findings.checked_source: University of Hamburg GLiM project page (official project description)
findings.observed: The map can be ordered from CCGM and the original GIS data are downloadable through the CCGM link; no open licence is stated for the polygon GIS.

findings.checked_source: ArcGIS FeatureServer mirror item used by the pilot (GLiM_Niveau_I)
findings.observed: licenseInfo is an empty string; accessInformation carries the citation only. Mirror provenance and upstream equivalence are not verified.
CC BY 3.0 applies to the separate 0.5-degree gridded dataset. This licence is not transferred to the polygon GIS and its coarse grid is not a substitute for the 1:3,750,000 polygon overlay.

legally_usable_alternative.product: Generalized Geology of the World: Bedrock Domains and Major Faults in GIS Format
legally_usable_alternative.provider: Geological Survey of Canada / Natural Resources Canada
legally_usable_alternative.license_summary: Worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual, non-exclusive licence, including commercial use, with attribution; third-party rights are excluded.
legally_usable_alternative.download_note: Not downloaded in this pilot. Any future fetch must be opt-in, bounded to the selected AOI/window and recorded with checksum; the GIS ZIP is roughly 550 MB so a full download is out of scope.
limitations: Approximately 1:35,000,000 generalized bedrock domains; far coarser than GLiM and not a drop-in substitute for local lithology.
Attribute legend must be reviewed and versioned before any process labels are assigned.
The USGS mrdata page is a distribution mirror, not the data owner; attribution must name the Geological Survey of Canada.
